channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Creative Australia: International Engagement Fund (October 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/international-engagement-fund
    Creative Australia · deadline 13 Oct 2026 · AUD 5,000 to 30,000. No application fee. No formal matching requirement, but assessment explicitly weighs diversity and scale of income and co-funding, including earned income, grants, sponsorship and in-kind contributions.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 15 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Samstag International Visual Arts Scholarships - Class of 2027
    https://samstag.adelaide.edu.au/scholarship/apply/
    Samstag Museum of Art, University of South Australia · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · AUD $75,000 tax-exempt stipend; institutional fees for one academic year of study (where applicable); return airfares; and travel and health insurance. No application fee.
